description: stoa-tls/src/lib.rs approved_provider() calls CryptoProvider::get_default().expect(...). If no default provider is installed at the call site, this panics rather than returning an error. Any crate that calls load_tls_server_config() before installing a provider will panic at runtime. Fix: return Result<Arc<CryptoProvider>, TlsError> from approved_provider() and propagate via ? in callers, or document the startup contract and add an assert at binary entry points rather than relying on panic text.
title: tls: approved_provider() panics if no CryptoProvider installed
